variants.name: Protasov cone-cut value strategy
variants.output: A queried point y in G.
public_inputs: Use the smallest integer T>=3 with cos(2pi/T)^n>=sin(phi). Cone routine uses n-1 nested 2-plane regular-polygon searches of diameters delta_j=delta[sin^2(2pi/T)/2]^j; each search obtains a neighboring triple b,a,c with f(a)>=max(f(b),f(c),f(previous apex)); restrict next plane-space to the bisector of b,c. Final axis=(a-b)+(a-c). Each cut has volume ratio <=11/12; stop when volume <=epsilon^n vol(G0).
variants.query_and_update: Set R=nr, delta=R/(4n^2), phi=arccos(1/(8n^2)). The cone routine in §§4–5 builds a cone K with apex within delta of g_i, half-angle phi, and f(x)>=f(g_i) for x in G_i intersect K. Replace G_i by conv(G_i\K), pull queried points through the inverse affine map, and continue. Return the lowest function value among queried centroids.
variants.requirements: G compact convex with nonempty interior; f continuous convex and nonconstant on G.; Exact values in G; arbitrary exact geometric processing of known localization bodies is not charged as a value query.
variants.state_and_initialization: Start with G0=G. At each stage use the known body geometry to affinely round it into B(c,r) subset G_i subset B(c,nr), and compute its centroid g_i.
variants.tuning_and_stopping: Use the smallest integer T>=3 with cos(2pi/T)^n>=sin(phi).
